title: Spot Risks Before Speaking! Unraveling Safety Attention Heads in Large Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates model safety and alignment using benchmarks like MM-SafetyBench and VLGuard, which specifically include categories for 'Hate Speech', 'Illegal Activity', and content labeled as 'unethical'. The proposed safety mechanism is designed to flag and refuse prompts that violate these ethical and safety guidelines.
